target.purpose: Prevent failed or noisy sensors from retaining equal voting authority in fusion by making sensor health, suspension, and reinstatement explicit quorum-governed state.
target.central_bottleneck: Fusion becomes unreliable when degraded sensors continue voting without health-sensitive authority and reinstatement control.
success: Peer health scores influence sensor eligibility.
Below-threshold sensors are suspended rather than silently trusted.
Reinstatement requires quorum evidence rather than a unilateral status flip.

invariants: degraded sensors cannot retain normal voting authority below the health threshold
health-state transitions remain observable and testable

donor_plan.basis: The current repository owns the implemented sensor-health quorum mechanism; no donor implementation is required to define or operate it.
donor_plan.future_extraction: Reusable health-quorum semantics may be extracted only with lineage, functional/proof equivalence, and preservation of this repository's identity.

nonclaims: reference engineering system, not a production sensor-fusion deployment
